test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A hemispherical bowl is made of 1 cm thick copper. The inner radius of the bowl is 6 cm. Find the cost to paint the outer curved surface area of the bowl, if the paint cost is ₹2 per cm². (Use pi = frac{22}7)
solution:
**Given:**

Inner radius (r₁) = 6 cm

Thickness = 1 cm

Outer radius (r₂) = Inner radius + Thickness = 6 + 1 = 7 cm

Cost of painting = ₹2 per cm²

pi = (22)/(7)

**Formula used:**

Curved surface area of a hemisphere = 2πr²

Cost of painting = Curved surface area × Cost per cm²

**Calculations:**

Outer curved surface area = 2πr₂²

⇒ = 2 × (22)/(7) × (7 × 7)

⇒ = 2 × (22)/(7) × 49

⇒ = (2156)/(7)

⇒ = 308 cm²

Cost of painting = Outer curved surface area × Cost per cm²

⇒ = 308 × 2

⇒ = ₹616

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
